description: Room-by-room home safety audit with costed fixes ranked by fall-risk reduction.
notes: Risk scores derive live from fix state; best-value fix computed by pts/$
shared/kit.js + kit.css empty at build time; full Kit fallback inlined

notes.note: Falls are the #1 senior injury and most are preventable with cheap fixes — ranking fixes by risk-reduced-per-dollar turns worry into a shoppable plan, and the affiliate revenue on grab bars is honest monetization. Weakest assumption: $29 one-time audits don't compound; the OT/agency tier has to carry the business.

FIXED: 'Mark top-priority fix done' button duplicated on every re-render (appended to card instead of cleared fixes box); fixed by appending into cleared container. Re-verified: single button, KPIs update, room switching works, zero errors.

notes.change: Killed the dead nav action (now a working 'How scoring works' button); added a persisted fall-risk-over-time trend chart that grows with every completed fix.
